d:
US President Donald Trump has ordered the Justice Department to seek the death penalty for child murderers and rapists or human traffickers who kill their victims, while directing faster executions of existing federal death sentences. Trump also targeted California Governor Gavin Newsom over his decision to commute all 548 state death row sentences to life without parole, calling it a shocking injustice and accusing him of standing with murderers.
Produced & Edited By Kashish Dhawan
